pc.name: Kellan Voss
pc.description: A village scout: a keen eye, a short temper, and a debt to the tavern he works off.

spine.premise: Three nights before the harvest moon, the fields of Hollowmere fail: the grain blackens at the root. The village believes a shadow has settled over the land.
spine.stakes: If the shadow is crowned at the harvest moon's peak, the blight becomes permanent and the village starves. If the player fails, the crown goes back onto the brow of the dead king.
spine.antagonist: Vesper the Hollow — the false prophet who wore the shadow crown's name before the last king, and came back for it.

beats.text: Learn what the shadow has done to the harvest
Find the candle that can unmake the crown
Pass the undercroft into the King's Crypt
Take the shadow crown from the dead king
Unmake the crown and bring the light back

cast.name: Brenna
cast.agenda: Keeper of the candle. Knows why the crown must not be recrowned, and will not say why. If the player threatens the village, she bars the tavern door.

cast.name: Tallow
cast.agenda: Hears everything; sells secrets for bread. Knows that Aldous keeps a spare key to the undercroft.

cast.name: Mayor Aldous
cast.agenda: Sold the crown's seal to a stranger three nights ago. Hides it. If pressed, he bolts for the undercroft with the key.

cast.name: Old Maren
cast.agenda: Knows the legend: the crown was forged for the king who died mid-crowning, and Vell's candle is the only thing that can unmake it. She tells it to whoever first gives her a piece of bread.

cast.name: Father Cael
cast.agenda: Blesses the undercroft door and will not let anyone pass unblessed. He does not know the blessing is the candle's light — only that the dark keeps off.

cast.name: Sable
cast.agenda: Opened the crypt door for the stranger three nights ago. Eaten with guilt. Will confess for a promise of forgiveness.

cast.name: Vesper
cast.agenda: The hollow thing wearing a prophet's name, come to reclaim the crown. Wants it back on the dead king's brow at the harvest moon's peak. Speaks softly, and never lies — which is worse.

cast.name: The Grave Wight
cast.agenda: Attacks anyone who touches the crown. It does not bargain.

events.name: The legend of the last king
events.trigger: Old Maren is given bread, or the harvest's blight is asked about
events.detail: The crown was forged for King Aldric the Last, who died mid-crowning. The shadow did not die with him. Vell's candle is the only light that can unmake it.

events.name: Marrow and Ash on the stairs
events.trigger: the player enters the undercroft without the candle's light
events.detail: Two cultists hired by the stranger hold the stairs. They fight to keep the stranger's secret, not out of conviction — the candle turns them away.

events.name: The crowning at the moon's peak
events.trigger: the player takes the crown from the altar
events.detail: Vesper reaches for the crown at the altar; the acolyte holds the approach. Beating her ends the adventure.

spine.finale: The harvest moon rises clear. Lanterns burn in the village square, and the candle of Vell gutters out its last wick — the shadow is gone, and the fields stand straight in the dark.

locations.name: The village square
locations.description: A cobbled square, a chapel on a rise, and the blackening fields beyond the walls.

locations.name: The tavern
locations.description: The Hearth, where woodsmoke and low voices compete. Brenna keeps the counter; Tallow waits tables.

locations.name: The mayor's hall
locations.description: Plain stone, little light. Aldous's seal hangs crooked over the door, and the room smells of cold ink.

locations.name: The undercroft
locations.description: Stone steps down from the chapel's crypt door, into cold that smells of wet rock and old incense.

locations.name: The King's Crypt
locations.description: The tomb of Aldric the Last. On a black basalt altar, a shadow moves where a crown should be.

npcs.name: Brenna
npcs.description: The tavern keeper. Dry voice, wet rag, and eyes that have watched this square for thirty years.
npcs.agenda: Keeper of the candle. Knows why the crown must not be recrowned, and will not say why.

npcs.name: Tallow
npcs.description: Brenna's apprentice. Small, quick, and always hungry.
npcs.agenda: Hears everything; sells secrets for bread. Knows that Aldous keeps a spare key to the undercroft.

npcs.name: Mayor Aldous
npcs.description: A thin man in a good coat that fits him too well.
npcs.agenda: Sold the crown's seal to a stranger three nights ago. Hides it. If pressed, he bolts for the undercroft with the key.

npcs.name: Old Maren
npcs.description: The herb-woman by the chapel steps. Her basket is always a step out of reach.
npcs.agenda: Knows the legend: the crown was forged for the king who died mid-crowning, and Vell's candle is the only thing that can unmake it.

npcs.name: Father Cael
npcs.description: The chapel priest. Kind face, hands that will not stop shaking.
npcs.agenda: Blesses the undercroft door and will not let anyone pass unblessed. He does not know the blessing is the candle's light — only that the dark keeps off.

npcs.name: Sable
npcs.description: The grave-digger. Heavy hands, and eyes that will not meet yours.
npcs.agenda: Opened the crypt door for the stranger three nights ago. Eaten with guilt. Will confess for a promise of forgiveness.

npcs.name: Vesper
npcs.description: A tall figure in a prophet's grey. A face like a candle seen through smoke.
npcs.agenda: The hollow thing wearing a prophet's name, come to reclaim the crown. Wants it back on the dead king's brow at the harvest moon's peak. Speaks softly, and never lies — which is worse.

npcs.name: The Grave Wight
npcs.description: The guardian of the crypt. A shape of cold that was a man once.
npcs.agenda: Attacks anyone who touches the crown. It does not bargain.

items.name: Candle of Vell
items.description: A white candle that has never burned. It is warm to the touch.

items.name: The Shadow Crown
items.description: A circlet of black iron. The shadow under it moves like something breathing.

items.name: Maren's herb pouch
items.description: Dried roots and a small knife. She trades it for stories.

items.name: A vial of grave salt
items.description: Grey salt that hisses near the dark. It slows a wight's step for a round.

encounters.name: The undercroft ambush
encounters.notes: Marrow and Ash were hired by the stranger to keep the stairs dark. They fight to keep the secret, not out of conviction — the candle of Vell turns them away. Use start_combat with these two stat blocks.

encounters.name: The wight in the King's Crypt
encounters.notes: The wight guards the altar and will not yield the crown. A vial of grave salt slows its step for a round (narrate it hesitating). Use start_combat with this stat block.

encounters.name: The crowning
encounters.notes: Vesper reaches for the crown at the harvest moon's peak; the acolyte holds her between the player and the altar. Beating her ends the adventure. Use start_combat with these two stat blocks.
